topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
consensus_response: To mitigate >3 dB gain variance, hybrid beamforming architectures combining analog and digital processing can enhance adaptability. Analog beam steering provides high gain, while digital beamforming enables adaptive nulling and interference mitigation. Optimized codebooks with hierarchical structures and machine learning-driven predictive modeling can further improve beam tracking and spectral efficiency.
reference_context: mmWave systems require optimized beamforming strategies to compensate for path loss and narrow beam characteristics, considering factors like user mobility and environmental changes.
